import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] powers = new long[18];

    static long compute(long num, int position) {
        long count = num / powers[position];
        if (num % powers[position] == 0)
            return position * count;
        long option1 = position * count + compute(num % powers[position], position - 1);
        long option2 = position * (count + 1) + compute(powers[position] - (num % powers[position]), position - 1);
        return Math.min(option1, option2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        powers[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= 17; ++i) {
            powers[i] = powers[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long number = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(compute(number, 17));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
